name: Frutiger Eco
summary: The aesthetic relies on high-gloss vector graphics, skeuomorphic textures, and a strictly enforced color palette of bright foliage greens and sky blues.
description: The aesthetic relies on high-gloss vector graphics, skeuomorphic textures, and a strictly enforced color palette of bright foliage greens and sky blues. Recurring material motifs include transparent glass globes, sprouting seedlings, wind turbines, compact fluorescent lightbulbs enclosing miniature landscapes, ladybugs, and pristine grassy hills. These elements are frequently heavily edited with lens flares, soft lighting, and glossy overlays to create a sanitized and utopian depiction of nature.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Nature, sustainability, futurism
